title: A Juggler CycleMin cycle forces two incompatible fan-quality logarithmic approximations
statement: A CycleMin cycle whose length L is a survivor-fan member forces two or more distinct fan-quality (length, odd-count) relations simultaneously — neighboring excursions, successive minima, or related subwords — so that the classical exponent-shift separation of powers of 2 and 3 kills the fan without requiring bounded partial quotients of log 2 / log 3.
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / Diophantine approximation of log 2 / log 3
tested_range: hug circuit census at L = 19, 84, 1054, 25781, 50508, 176251; exponent-neighbor ratios on 9 leftover-quality competition rows; fan-neighbor theta ratios on certified fans A (56 members) and B (5 members); leftover-sum search on 88 quality lengths
counterexamples: hug circuits are only (1,1) and (2,1) on every leftover seed through 176251 (5415 OE + 13226 OOE at L=50508)
at L=50508, theta(L+1)/theta(L) = 4.59e4 and theta(L-1)/theta(L) = 6.88e4, but the cycle does not constrain the neighbor
fan A pair 176251, 478245 has theta-ratio 0.982 and both Dirichlet-good: Q-step neighbors are not exponent-neighbors
two-good split 1054+50508=51562 is a lattice identity; hug still only OE/OOE; 25781+25781 is archived equal-valleys
parent step Q=301994 has theta ~ 2/3 (wrong-side convergent), not a cheap returning circuit
notes: Phase 0 only. The literature is stored and the neighbor-relation distinction is the reusable output. Baker-type gap floors stay REFUTED as leftover killers (juggler_baker_kills_near_convergents). Sibling Attack B is CLOSE (juggler_cycle_padic_coupling); sibling Attack C is PROMOTE (juggler_cycle_walk_fan_growth). Not a halt theorem.
